document.title: Secvisogram is not affected by CVE-2026-111497 in the Node.js Brotli decoder

notes.text: Brotli decoder in Node.js (24.x before 24.22.1, 22.x before 22.23.4) mishandles crafted compressed streams and may lead to remote code execution.
notes.title: CVE Description

threats.details: Node.js is only used to build Secvisogram. The delivered application consists of static files served by nginx and executed in the browser. It does not contain the Node.js runtime and does not decode Brotli data with Node.js.
